corrective_boundary.read_scope: the exact unchanged 21-artifact observability set and prior result/review/root-decision chain
required_invariants: derive count, bytes, lines, per-row lengths, and set digest mechanically
reject unknown, duplicate, missing, mismatched, or special-file rows
bind the reconciliation result to its actual result-only lease
do not claim source authorship or runtime behavior

claim_ceiling: No observability source acceptance or behavior claim is supported until a truthful reconciliation result and full independent behavior review pass.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim public integration, product behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
